reason: Method relies on COT positioning data, sentiment, and discretionary news failure confirmation across futures/FX/commodities rather than concrete long-only daily-bar rules for US stocks.

universe.description: Futures, currencies, commodities, occasional stocks via COT reports

setup.rule: Identify overcrowded positioning via COT speculator extremes
setup.quote: when I see people are way too long something you know I'm looking to get short when I see that participants are way too short something I'm looking to get long

entry.rule: Enter on news failure day confirming reversal
entry.quote: if I'm looking at okay everybody's short here here I'm looking to get long what's going to be my confirmation I do it on what I call a news failure event

stop.rule: Stop if new extreme beyond entry day extreme
stop.quote: if it takes out the lows of that day well then I'm stopped out

exits.rule: Exit when COT positioning returns to neutral
exits.quote: the positioning data goes back to a neutral reading and that's where I take my profit

sizing.quote: I personally risk 70 basis points on each trade

ambiguities.issue: No explicit US stock long-only daily rules; trades mixed long/short across asset classes
